method: MACE-MP-0 medium with D3(BJ) dispersion to 15 Å, 372 atoms. The interlayer was held 0.5 ps at 300 K on the ceramic slab, whose bottom 2 Å stay fixed, then relaxed at 0 K, with the interlayer and its upper half each moved rigidly to their height of lowest energy. Separation energy: work to split the cell with both parts relaxed, at the interlayer, the weaker of the interface and the middle of the interlayer. Strength: peak traction of the rigid opening at that site
